sentences.text: Grand Theft Auto V is an action-adventure video game developed by Rockstar North and published by Rockstar Games .	Rockstar North	Rockstar North	Rockstar Games	Rockstar Games	Grand Theft Auto	Grand Theft Auto	action-adventure	Action-adventure game

It was released on 17 September 2013 for the PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360 , on 18 November 2014 for the PlayStation 4 and Xbox One , and on 14 April 2015 for Microsoft Windows .	PlayStation 3	PlayStation 3	Xbox 360	Xbox 360	PlayStation 4	PlayStation 4	Xbox One	Xbox One	Microsoft Windows	Microsoft Windows
It is the first main entry in the Grand Theft Auto series since 2008 's Grand Theft Auto IV .	Grand Theft Auto	Grand Theft Auto	Grand Theft Auto IV	Grand Theft Auto IV

Set within the fictional state of San Andreas , based on Southern California , the single-player story follows three criminals and their efforts to commit heists while under pressure from a government agency .	Southern California	Southern California	single-player	Single-player video game
The open world design lets players freely roam San Andreas ' open countryside and the fictional city of Los Santos , based on Los Angeles .	open world	open world	Los Angeles	Los Angeles
The game is played from either a first-person or third-person view and its world is navigated on foot or by vehicle .	first-person	first-person view	third-person view	third-person view
Players control the three lead protagonists throughout single-player and switch between them both during and outside of missions .	single-player	Single-player video game
The story is centred on the heist sequences , and many missions involve shooting and driving gameplay .
A `` wanted '' system governs the aggression of law enforcement response to players who commit crimes .

Grand Theft Auto Online , the online multiplayer mode , lets up to 30 players explore the open world and engage in cooperative or competitive game matches .	Grand Theft Auto	Grand Theft Auto	multiplayer	Multiplayer video game	open world	open world	Grand Theft Auto Online	Grand Theft Auto Online	online multiplayer	online multiplayer	cooperative	Cooperative gameplay

Development began soon after Grand Theft Auto IV 's release and was shared between many of Rockstar 's studios worldwide .	Grand Theft Auto	Grand Theft Auto	Grand Theft Auto IV	Grand Theft Auto IV	Development	Development of Grand Theft Auto V

The development team drew influence from many of their previous projects such as Red Dead Redemption and Max Payne 3 , and designed the game around three lead protagonists to innovate on the core structure of its predecessors .	Red Dead Redemption	Red Dead Redemption	Max Payne 3	Max Payne 3

Much of the development work constituted the open world 's creation , and several team members conducted field research around California to capture footage for the design team .	open world	open world
The game 's soundtrack features an original score composed by a team of producers who collaborated over several years .	original score	The Music of Grand Theft Auto V

Extensively marketed and widely anticipated , the game broke industry sales records and became the fastest-selling entertainment product in history , earning US $ 800 million in its first day and US $ 1 billion in its first three days .
It received widespread critical acclaim , with praise directed at its multiple protagonist design , open world , presentation and gameplay .	open world	open world
However , it caused controversies related to its depiction of women and a mission featuring torture during a hostage interrogation .	caused controversies	Controversies surrounding Grand Theft Auto V

Considered one of seventh generation console gaming 's most significant titles and among the best games ever made , it won year-end accolades including Game of the Year awards from several gaming publications .	seventh generation console gaming	History of video game consoles (seventh generation)	best games ever made	List of video games considered the best	won year-end accolades	List of accolades received by Grand Theft Auto V	Game of the Year	List of Game of the Year awards	gaming publications	Video game journalism
It has shipped over 80 million copies and is one of the best-selling video games of all time .	best-selling video games of all time	List of best-selling video games
